description: Example visual bible for story image continuity. Copy into a project folder as visual_bible.json and customize per story.

world.base_palette: polluted crimson sky, ash gray debris, rust brown metal, sickly green radiation hints, muted cinematic contrast
world.camera_language: mostly side/back views, readable story action, grounded cinematic realism
world.approved_reference_recipe: cinematic 16:9 shelter interior; Lâm Tịch sits/kneels in the left third with a readable dirty but beautiful three-quarter face; Tần Dã lies or half-reclines in the right third wearing black tactical clothing, wounded abdomen, clear side-profile face; warm oil lantern between them; torn tarp walls and patched canvas frame the scene; foreground rusty bucket, bottle, scraps and survival props; background opens to ruined industrial wasteland with haze and distant structures; warm amber lantern against cold daylight, deep shadows, realistic grime

Lâm Tịch.appearance: beautiful but fragile sixteen-year-old Asian wasteland scavenger girl, delicate clear facial features under soot and grime, large wary tired eyes, cracked lips, messy black hair tied back with loose strands, slim malnourished body, dirty torn gray-brown coat, quiet stubborn survival beauty, not glamorous, not clean

Tần Dã.appearance: wounded Asian male mercenary with a clear sharply rendered face, strong straight brows, steady righteous eyes, principled protective aura, restrained masculine dignity, wet messy black hair, black tactical coat, lying or half-reclining because he cannot stand, feverish but still upright in spirit, blood-stained abdomen, not villainous

Khu 17 ngoài thành.appearance: radioactive junkyard outside a distant safe-zone wall, red polluted sky, rusted appliances, broken concrete, toxic dust

props.thịt hộp: small precious sealed can of meat, survival treasure, dirty metal surface
props.tinh thạch: tiny crystal shard, subtle glow, not oversized fantasy gem
props.bức tường bê tông sập: collapsed concrete wall used for hiding
